speech: Hot wash sheets, a new purifier, and I still woke up blocked. Here's why. That's because
traditional cleaning doesn't get the dust mites out. They live deep in your mattress,
and they leave behind the actual thing your body reacts to. And the thing that finally got them out
of my bed, these little cards I started using a few weeks ago, capture cards. It's a flat card
that works differently than an air purifier. Instead of just filtering the air, it goes after
the dust mites themselves, which is what was actually setting off my reactions in the first place.
A plant-derived pheromone lure pulls them up out of the mattress and the adhesive holds them on
the card. No plug, no spray. I just slid one under my mattress.
